info.title: API.SH: Genius
info.description: The Genius API from API.SH: public Genius data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A Genius artist: name, alternate names, description, images, verified flags, followers, Instagram/Twitter/Facebook handles (also as full links in `social_links`) and the 20 most popular songs. With `include=albums`: `albums` (id, name, link, cover, release date), 50 per page, with `albums_next_page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/genius-artist

parameters.name: albums_page
parameters.description: With `include=albums`: page of albums (default 1). Pass `albums_next_page` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One song's metadata by Genius id or link (no lyrics): title, artists (primary, featured), album and other albums, release date, description, page views, annotation, comment, contributor and pyong counts, producers, writers and other credits, recording location, tags, samples/covers/remixes and other relationships, translations, media links (Spotify, YouTube, SoundCloud, Apple Music). With `include=annotations`: `annotations`, the song's annotations (explanation text, votes, comment count, verified, pinned and review state; the annotated lines themselves are not returned).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/genius-song

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Or a genius.com song page link.

parameters.name: annotations_limit
parameters.description: With `include=annotations`: how many annotated passages (1-50, default 20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A song's annotations (the explanations readers write): annotation and referent id, link, whether it is the song description, review state, the explanation text, votes, comments, verified and pinned flags, authors with their attribution and the verifier. The annotated lyric lines are not returned. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/genius-song-annotations

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The numeric song id (or a genius.com/songs/<id> link).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

A public Genius user by id or login: name, login, IQ, role, avatar and header image, about text, linked artist, followers and following, counts of annotations, answers, comments, forum posts, pyongs, questions and transcriptions, and join date.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
